Book correction: The answer key says "One dose insufficient; 6 doses needed in 24 hours". The first half is right, but 6 is only the number of doses that fit into 24 hours when one is given every T hours (t = 0, T, \dots, 5T \approx 23.1 h); six doses give an AUC of about 199 mg h/L, far more than 150. The least number of doses that meets the requirement is 4 (AUC \approx 157.5 mg h/L), as shown above.
